other_conditions: Must be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
Must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year.
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
Must not be a member of EPF, NPS, or ESIC.
Must not be an income tax payer.
Must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
Eligible for leave travel concession for journeys to religious/historical places or hometown within the last two years.
benefits_summary: Provides a leave travelling concession of ₹2000 per journey, payable after return upon submission of self‑declaration or proof.
